name: Date Masamune
source:
"Women? Not interested... "

The name of the man who used to frequent the shop is Date Masamune, the young head of Oshu. He is the "One-Eyed Dragon". A solitary man who never lets anyone get close to him. But what is the secret behind his isolation?

Temperament: Calm and collected
Likes: Zunda mochi
